methodology: Editorial JACO use-case screening, not a measured benchmark or guarantee. Hosting, tool support and prices must be checked live.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next
models.rationale: Purpose-built for coding agents and long tool workflows; 256k context claimed by author.
models.constraint: 80B total weights still require considerable memory. Not a verified mobile option.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.rationale: Promising for long-context code and multi-step agents; asymmetric prefill/decode design.
models.constraint: Very large weights. Vendor benchmark scores need independent JACO reproduction.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.rationale: Flexible reasoning and native vision; practical candidate for quantized workstation experiments.
models.constraint: Not recommended for Pixel 10 Pro without measured memory, decode and temperature tests.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.rationale: Very large multimodal long-horizon reasoning model with 1M-context claim.
models.constraint: Special license needs review. Vast model: cloud inference only in this JACO plan.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.rationale: Sparse/linear attention architecture and agent-workflow emphasis.
models.constraint: Large total weights; low active count does not mean phone-scale storage.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.rationale: JACO already has real LiteRT-LM Gemma 4 E2B inference on Android; reliable baseline.
models.constraint: Small-model tool chaining and long-repo tasks require testing; ACFQ not integrated.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.rationale: Reasoning and tool use; alternative to compare with Qwen on a capable workstation.
models.constraint: Requires a runtime that handles the Harmony format correctly. Not verified on Pixel.
